resources.label: Read My Schedule
resources.instruction: Go back to the chat where you built your presentation. Same chat, still. Ask it something it could not possibly have known five minutes ago. Claude will ask permission before it reads anything — approve it.
resources.content:
What does my schedule look like tomorrow?
List every event with its title, start time, and how long it runs.
resources.note: Those are your real meetings, read live from your calendar. Nothing was pasted in.

resources.label: Find a Free Slot
resources.instruction: Still the same chat. Now ask it something no chatbot could answer without access to your actual data.
resources.content:
Look at my calendar for the next 2 weeks.
Find the first 3-hour block where I am completely free.
Tell me the date, day, and exact time.

resources.label: Send the Heist Invite
resources.instruction: Replace [PARTNER EMAIL] with a real address. Notice how little you are telling it — no dates, no agenda, no copy. Your Minion has sat through this entire session and already knows the rest.
resources.content:
Book that 3-hour slot and invite [PARTNER EMAIL].

Title it: Operation: Steal the Sun — Mission Planning Session

Write the invite description yourself using everything we worked out today — the mission, what the 374 records told us, our special tool, and what we need to decide in this session. Make it exciting enough that they actually turn up.

Then tell me exactly what you did.
resources.note: Count what that took. It recalled the whole session, scanned two weeks of calendar, picked a slot, wrote the copy, created the event, and invited someone. You wrote three lines.
